launcher.notes: LAUNCH FIXED. The real boot crash is gone, with the actual crash report captured this time: NullPointerException inside MathHelper during 'Initializing game'. Root cause: the Kinetrix FPS Boost math optimizer (shipped in 2.6.0, hidden behind the 2.7.0 loading-screen crash ever since) accidentally stopped MathHelper's own static initialization from running, so the first texture/model load hit null lookup tables and crashed. Ultra Forge 5 rebuilds the optimizer: the vanilla tables always initialize, every instruction is rebuilt safely, and the patched MathHelper is self-verified before it reaches the JVM — any doubt keeps vanilla math, so the game always boots. Verified on real bytecode: OptiFine-patched pipeline passes all four hot functions (integer ones bit-exact over 4096 samples); FoamFix and the Kinetrix loading screen (emblem logo, orbit spinner, real-time progress) are byte-identical and intact. Old ultra3/ultra4 jars are swept automatically - exactly one Ultra Forge 5 jar, no duplicates. Bundles Kinetrix Client v3.3.6.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. The hub now uses the module menu window proportions (no more near-fullscreen). New "Customize Cosmetics" button on the pause screen for in-world/server customization. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.
